objective: Build the missing robot contact-to-release layer and reconstruct one canonical film-regime source plus one current company-research source without creating an unbounded historical paper chain.

request_interpretation.depth: A private 52-premise robot-joint failure is the coverage gate; the public prose must supply the insight required to solve it without printing the problem.
request_interpretation.formula: Every display equation has Korean causal annotations and one adjacent FormulaNote, with source equation identity and model limits preserved.
request_interpretation.visual: Twelve mechanism-specific causal labs change geometry, metrics and a diagnosis; styling or color change alone is insufficient.
request_interpretation.source: Read complete primary artifacts, retain author intent and non-transfer boundaries, and stop source recursion at a declared reader-capability floor.
request_interpretation.small_model: Persist premise packets, source slices, scientific corrections, Viz state contracts and QA defects for bounded 4B/9B replay.

gap_audit.downstream_capability: Diagnose cold drag, hot film loss, fretting, pitting, wear, debris, backlash growth and ingress with bounded calculations and tests.

domain_floor.capability: preserve four-regime and minimum-film equation identity

foundation_floor.stop_reason: Older sources add lineage but no premise absent from the shared concept floor or the private transfer gate.

groups.T01-T07: contact inventory, load sharing, curvature, Hertz state and alignment
groups.T08-T13: roughness, real area, running-in and rolling/sliding/spin/reversal
groups.T14-T22: viscosity, wedge balance, four regimes, dimensionless groups and film identity
groups.T23-T32: lambda boundary, starvation, grease, friction decomposition, heat and preload feedback
groups.T33-T40: rating life, RCF, surface distress, wear and debris feedback
groups.T45-T52: observer limits, rig hierarchy, transfer and release evidence

private_transfer_gate.publication_policy: The compound scenario remains private; every premise maps to prose, a formula, a causal lab, a source boundary or an evidence gate.

sources.read_scope: complete PDF including equations, figures, conclusions and references
sources.boundary: smooth, isothermal, fully flooded theoretical elliptical contacts; not transient grease supply, wear or life
mechanism logic transfers; historical data and space selections are not modern robot allowables
first-order historical approximation, not current manufacturer rating or proof that lambda determines individual life

sources.read_scope: complete official JATS XML, 14 TIFF figures and 9 tables
sources.access_note: Publisher HTML/PDF returned 403; official mdpi-res artifacts were complete and used instead of snippets.
sources.boundary: railway double cylindrical roller bearing conditions; friction reductions are test-specific and lubricant interactions were outside interpretation

events.observed: The actuator path ended at component load and catalog quantities.
events.inference: Readers could size torque but could not explain changing friction, film, wear or ingress.
events.verification: Twelve sections and labs cover the complete local-contact-to-release chain.

events.observed: Cold current, hot efficiency, debris, fretting and ingress can fit contradictory single-cause stories.
events.inference: A vocabulary survey would not create diagnostic transfer.
events.decision: Use a private 52-premise compound failure as the authoring gate.
events.verification: Every premise group is mapped in the content spec and QA checks causal controls.

events.observed: MDPI HTML/PDF returned 403 while the official JATS, figures and tables were accessible.
events.inference: Search snippets would be incomplete, but the publisher artifacts were sufficient for a full reconstruction.
events.decision: Parse the structured artifact and inspect all visual/table evidence.
events.verification: The source page preserves methods, rigs, repeats, adverse variants, conclusions and admitted limits.

events.observed: A draft combined coefficient 3.42 with U/G/W exponents from a different Hamrock-Dowson family.
events.inference: Correct-looking notation can still be scientifically invalid when equation fragments are mixed.
events.decision: Treat coefficient, exponents, dimensionless-group definitions and source equation number as one immutable record; restore equation 26 with coefficient 3.63.
events.verification: The source spec now uses 3.63 U^0.68 G^0.49 W^-0.073(1-exp(-0.68k)) and explains E'=2E*, minimum versus central film and model family.

events.observed: Every retained source cited older contact, flow and viscosity work.
events.inference: Promoting every antecedent would make the reading path infinite without improving the hardest diagnosis.
events.decision: Keep one canonical domain source, one current evidence source, embed two complete references and cite older lineage only.
events.verification: The spec declares a fully used source budget of two and no older standalone routes were created.

events.observed: Source collapsing changed category visibility expectations in older tests.
events.inference: The regression contract had to encode the new reader policy, not preserve obsolete immediate exposure.
events.decision: Require concept visibility, source invisibility by default and source visibility after explicit expansion.
events.verification: The final connected local suite passed 100/100 and the public focused suite passed 32/32.

events.observed: A local build does not prove the reverse-proxied site changed.
events.inference: Service restart and public-host browser QA are required completion gates.
events.decision: Restart cm-blog.service, curl all new routes and run Playwright against the public host.
events.verification: Service active at 22:49 KST, all requested routes HTTP 200, public suite 32/32.

qa.typescript: repository-wide check remains non-green because of pre-existing unrelated diagnostics; no changed tribology, ODE or floor-policy file was reported
qa.deployment: cm-blog.service active after restart at 22:49 KST; public routes HTTP 200
